# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Sitting on circa 11.5 acres with additional 1/40 moiety of 60 acres commonage A property that simply has it all! The property is a truly rare package, fabulous house, panoramic views, on the outkirsts of a major town, circa 11.5 acres of paddocks and grounds. The house itself sits overlooking the River Suir and the town of Clonmel offering a spectacular night time vista.

- Dispozice: 5 bed
